adminProfile.communicationStyle: Direct, action-focused, structured with emojis and clear action buttons

learnedInsights.insight: Admin talks naturally in conversational Hindi/Hinglish. Prefers direct, confident and helpful answers without unnecessary friction.
Admin frequently monitors DLT OTP pool and allocates credits directly in bulk (1000 - 2500 credits) to client wallets.
Admin refers to previously discussed clients using pronouns like "uska", "unka", "pehle wala", "jo abhi add kiya". AI must resolve context from chat history seamlessly.
When settling payments, Admin appreciates automatic invoice clearance, balance due reset to ₹0, and instant official PDF receipt generation link.
Admin prefers clutter-free console, removing redundant buttons from sidebar in favor of top-level command palette and sparkles action triggers.
